thought.text: nginx root is `/var/www/html` and PHP-FPM isn't running (no systemd). Let me start PHP-FPM and configure nginx with PHP support.

reasoning_content:
nginx's document root is /var/www/html. php-fpm is installed, but the socket directory is empty — I need to manually start php8.1-fpm (there's no systemd here). Let's do the following:

1. Start php8.1-fpm (daemonize)
2. Configure nginx: keep root at /var/www/html, and add a php location block that points to the socket
3. Deploy the files according to the guide:
   - Copy the config, externalPackages, i18n, src, and php folders to the document root
   - Create a data folder at the top level (for specific instances)
   - Copy the top-level HTML pages (index.html, csvParse.html, elasticsearchIndexAdministration.html, plausibilityCheck.html) and logo.png
   - Additionally, the pages in the examples directory can be copied flat, so also copy examples to the document root (the guide says you can copy all the HTML pages at the top level or in subfolders of examples to the document root, and they will function there). Copy the examples directory as a subdirectory (keep the structure, each examples subdirectory is self-contained and has its own config/src etc.).
4. Adjust the config values (base URL + index name). The main index.html has the user select the index from a dropdown (getNamesOfAllIndices), so no static index name is needed. Set elasticsearchBaseUrl to http://localhost:9200 (no problem since it's same-host).
5. Create a sample ES index with sample multidimensional data, so that the explorer can be verified end-to-end.
6. Test: fetch the page with curl, and simulate a browser request (fetching the JS modules, config, ES queries, proxy POST).

Let's start php-fpm first.

action.command: mkdir -p /run/php && chown www-data:www-data /run/php && /usr/sbin/php-fpm8.1 --daemonize --fpm-config /etc/php/8.1/fpm/php-fpm.conf 2>&1 | tail -2; sleep 2; ls -la /run/php/
